option_relations.rationale: Peritoneal carcinomatosis is a common complication of advanced ovarian cancer, where cancer cells spread to the peritoneum.
High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma is the most common type of serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary, and metastatic disease is implied by the vignette.
Recurrent Ovarian Serous Adenocarcinoma with Metastatic Disease directly describes the clinical scenario and is equivalent to the provided leaf, which is a type of ovarian serous adenocarcinoma.

Recurrent stage IIIC papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary with BRCA1-positive somatic mutation is a highly specific description that is equivalent to the provided leaf, which is a type of serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary, with additional details from the vignette.
